title: Berlin Timetable Change - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Two dates this winter.** The new timetable starts on **Sunday 13 December 2026**, and the new VBB fares start on **1 January 2027**.

**Regional trains return to the Stadtbahn.** The works between Charlottenburg and Ostbahnhof end on 12 December, so the **RE1 and RE7** cross the centre again; the RB23 stays between Golm and Potsdam-Griebnitzsee all of 2027.

**More trains north and south.** **RE3 and RE5 run hourly** along their whole lines, RE5 trains between Berlin and Neustrelitz run until 23:00 every day, and the new **RE9** links Angermünde and Berlin Hbf.

**Some lines get worse.** The **RE4 ends at Wustermark** until about July 2027, the RE2 to Cottbus ends at Lübbenau with buses beyond, and the **S1 and S5 drop to a 5, 5, 10 minute rush hour** on their busiest stretches.
**Fares rise 3.72 percent on average.** The **AB single stays at 4.00 euros**, the 4-trip card goes to 13.20, the Umweltkarte AB subscription to 84.30 and the **Deutschlandticket to 66.80 euros**.
**My move:** save the new times of your two key trips once the planners show them, and buy 4-trip cards in December: old-price tickets stay valid until **30 June 2027**.
